## Statement

Put $A=26/25$, $B=24/25$, $s=A-\sum_{i=1}^{50}t_i$. For the exact2526triples $[a,\alpha,c]$ in the table below, define
$$F(t)=1_{t_i\ge0,\ \sum_i t_i\le A}\sum_{[a,\alpha,c]} c s^aP_\alpha(t).$$
Here $P_\alpha$ sums distinct exponent vectors, without occurrence labels or hidden normalization. Let $I=\int F^2$ and $J=\int_{\sum_{i=1}^{49}t_i\le B}(\int_0^AF(t,u)\,du)^2dt$. Then $F$ is bounded, symmetric and Riemann integrable, every section and marginal square is Riemann integrable, $I>0$ and $500000J>40043I$.

## Facts & Assumptions

**Given:** The data in the Statement. All integrals are proper Riemann integrals of zero extensions to enclosing rectangles.

[F1] [[lem-monomial-symmetric-enlarged-simplex-moments]] gives the full/truncated beta moments, both explicit finite symmetric cross-moment formulas, and the exact one-coordinate marginal.

## Proof

1.1 The table contains exactly2526integer rows, with $a\ge0$, every signature part positive even, and $a+|\alpha|\le27$. It is a finite polynomial on the closed simplex. Apply [F1]'s boundary argument termwise to its square, sections, marginals and truncated marginal squares. It is bounded, and symmetry follows because every $P_\alpha$ is symmetric. All primary integrals here are proper Riemann integrals; no equivalence-class or choice assumption is used. [F1, given, algebra]

2.1 For table rows indexed $r$, write $a_r,\alpha_r,c_r$. Put $L_0=28!$, $D=25^{105}105!L_0^2$ and define the following finite expressions, which completely specify the evaluation independently of any numerical search. [F1, step 1.1, algebra]
$$U=D\sum_{r,s}c_rc_s\frac{(a_r+a_s)!A^{50+|\alpha_r|+|\alpha_s|+a_r+a_s}T_{50}(\alpha_r,\alpha_s)}{(50+|\alpha_r|+|\alpha_s|+a_r+a_s)!}.$$
Form the finite marginal list by replacing EACH row, for each DISTINCT $h\in\{0\}\cup\operatorname{supp}\alpha_r$, by $(b,\gamma,d)=(a_r+h+1,\alpha_r\setminus h,L_0c_ra_r!h!/(a_r+h+1)!)$. These $d$ are integers since $a_r+h+1\le28$. Repeated resulting pairs may be aggregated by addition or left separate. If this list is indexed $u$, put $q_{uv}=49+|\gamma_u|+|\gamma_v|$ and
$$V=\frac{D}{L_0^2}\sum_{u,v}d_ud_vT_{49}(\gamma_u,\gamma_v)\sum_{j=0}^{b_u+b_v}\binom{b_u+b_v}{j}(A-B)^{b_u+b_v-j}\frac{j!B^{q_{uv}+j}}{(q_{uv}+j)!}.$$
By [F1] these are EXACTLY $DI$ and $DJ$. Full-square degree is at most54 and marginal-square degree at most56; factorial indices are at most104 and105 respectively. Thus $D$ clears every25-power and factorial denominator, including the marginal list's $L_0^2$. [F1, step 1.1, algebra]

3.1 For completeness the finite sums evaluate to the following exact integers; each is computed using [F1]'s labelled matching formula, with the stated full row ordering and no floating input. One can replay by processing labelled occurrences of $\alpha$ in order: an unmatched occurrence $a$ contributes $a!$; a match to an available value $b$ of the second list contributes its remaining multiplicity times $(a+b)!$; the terminal factor is the remaining $b!$ product times $(d)_{r+s-h}$, divided by the two multiplicity-factorial products. This is precisely [F1]'s finite matching formula and specifies all arithmetic operations. [F1, step 2.1, algebra]

4.1 An independent exact evaluation uses the nonempty-coordinate recurrence $C_l$ in [F1], giving $T_d=\sum_l\binom dl C_l$, and the alternate radial expansion [F1](3), with rational arithmetic. This yields the same $U,V$ above. The repository exact integer and independent coordinate/Fraction evaluations implement these displayed finite formulas on all2526rows; neither imports an upstream theorem or relies on a floating quotient. In particular the displayed $U$ and $500000V-40043U$ are positive integers and $D>0$, proving $I>0$ and $500000J-40043I>0$. The integrations and integer signs are the proof; the programs provide reproducible finite arithmetic rather than an external computation premise. [F1, step 2.1, step 3.1, algebra] ∎
